summary: Iteration 4 tested the per-session check-ins on backend and frontend. Testing ran at 02:30 Saturday 14 Nov 2026 Adelaide time, so current_slot was ('2026-11-13', 'evening'), which is the after-midnight case. New suite tests/test_iteration4_sessions.py has 15 tests: 12 pass, 3 fail. With the older suites (quarterly test deselected) 61 tests ran and 57 passed. All 4 failures come from one root cause: some endpoints still use the calendar date instead of the current session's date. All the requested core behaviour works: session key/label; second_session_free; via=paid_earlier; checkout returns 400 when the second session is free; a paid_earlier check-in does not make another session free; a paid check-in on another date gives 402; checkout meta.session is set; 400 'already checked in for this session'; another session does not block the current one; door value counts each date once while sessions counts check-ins; family check-in attaches only to the current session's check-in; admin roster grouped by session with per-session headcounts and the default date set to the session date; summary new_checkins includes session; bonus progress and reminders de-duplicate dates. UI: landing perk texts are correct and no '1 x drink' text remains. A non-subscriber who paid for the day session sees 'Check in free' and the evening-free note, checks in, and history shows '4pm–late · Free (paid earlier)' and '10am–2pm · Paid $5'. A subscriber with kid Mia sees 'A free drink and snack included · With Mia'. A plain non-subscriber at 390px sees 'Check in & pay $5' and is sent to square.link, which was blocked, so the payment stayed PENDING with meta.session='evening'. Staff toast reads 'TEST hostc checked in · 4pm–late'. Admin roster shows Day 1 person and Evening 4 people, with the label 'Free · paid earlier today'.

minor.issue: checkins_today counts {date: local calendar date}. Between 00:00 and 04:59 the evening session belongs to the previous date, so the count is 0 while people are checked in. Seen: 0 vs 2. Use current_slot()[0].

The default date is local_now().date() rather than the session date. After midnight the Session summary tab opens on an empty next day. attendees also counts each check-in row, so someone at both sessions counts as 2 (likely intended, but confirm).

A game logged after midnight during the evening session (no played_at) is stored with played_at = the calendar day (2026-11-14), not the session date (2026-11-13). The check-in stays 'unlogged', the reminder banner keeps showing, and the log-every-session raffle bonus can be lost. unlogged_checkins also uses '$lt today', so after midnight the reminder banner shows for the evening session that is still running. Use the session date (current_slot) as the default played_at and as the cutoff for reminders, and check the frontend Game Log date default too.

ui_bugs.issue: A non-host whose second session is free (paid_earlier) gets the toast 'Checked in with free host admission'. It should be something like 'Checked in free – you paid for the day session'.

integration_issues.issue: Shows 'You checked in on Fri, 13 Nov but haven't logged a game' during the still-running evening session (backend root cause above).

issues: admin-checkin-session-count shows '1 PEOPLE'. It should be singular ('1 person').
The date filter is a native <input type=date> (browser default picker), not the shadcn Calendar.

action_items: Use the session date (current_slot()[0]) for admin_summary.checkins_today and as the default date for /admin/sessions
POST /api/logs: default played_at to the session date (current_slot()[0]); also allow that date when it is 'yesterday' after midnight. Update the frontend Game Log default date to match
unlogged_checkins: exclude the current session date, not just the calendar today
CheckInPanel: correct the success toast for second_session_free (non-host) users
critical_code_review_comments: The midnight rollover is handled in current_slot, but other time-based code paths (admin_summary, session_summary, create_log, unlogged_checkins) still use local_now().date(), so they disagree with the check-in date from 00:00 to 04:59.
paid_earlier keys off via='paid' for the date regardless of session. This is fine for a two-session day and a paid_earlier row does not chain (verified).
Earlier tests in test_mbgg_api.py and test_iteration3_features.py assumed the check-in date is the calendar date. They were updated to use the session date (test files only).
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ users and their check-ins, payments and sessions were created, and all were removed, along with login_attempts for TEST_ emails. Pending Square links were deleted through the fixture cleanup and nothing was paid. quarter_awards was not touched; the quarterly test was deselected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/ -n 0 --deselect tests/test_iteration3_features.py::TestQuarterly. The quarterly test deletes all quarter_awards, so avoid it. test_iteration4_sessions computes SLOT_DATE/SLOT/OTHER itself and inserts other-session check-ins in Mongo. The 3 'after-midnight' tests only fail between 00:00 and 04:59 Adelaide time and pass at other hours, so rerun them then or after the fix. For the UI: python3 tests/ui_fixtures.py setup && python3 tests/ui_seed_iter4.py (nonsub gets a 'paid' check-in for the other session; hostc becomes host). Clean up with ui_fixtures.py cleanup. Block **/*square*/** in Playwright and use an async route handler (a lambda with a tuple raised an error). Login inputs are login-email-input, login-password-input and login-submit-button.
rca of the issue: Root cause: local_now().date() is used instead of current_slot()[0] in admin_summary (line ~859), session_summary (~938), create_log (~670) and unlogged_checkins (~552). To reproduce, between 00:00 and 04:59 Adelaide time check in (date = yesterday) and then GET /api/admin/summary (checkins_today = 0); or POST /api/logs without played_at (played_at = today) and the reminder for yesterday stays. Fix: route these through the session date.
